newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says no move yet in iron ore talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says no move yet in iron ore talks.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd and Japanese steelmakers were locked in iron ore negotiations on Wednesday after the talks resumed this week following a holiday season break, a BHP spokesman said on Wednesday.
There was no word of any settlements in the Tokyo talks, which started late last year and cover the 1997/98 (April-March) Japanese fiscal year, the spokesman said.
BHP and other Australian iron ore producers won increases of between five and six percent for lump and fine ore in the previous year.

Industry sources said the Australian negotiators would look to better these terms in 1997/98, although they faced a still-weak-than-expected international steel market due to inventory overhangs of finished steel.
Japan took about 46 percent of Australia's estimated iron ore exports of 129 million tonnes for calendar 1996, Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics figures show.
